lead_raw_text:
The structure of Yb2AgHg2Sb2 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 12-atom unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Hg and Ag each adopt tetrahedral Sb coordination, while Yb centers have eight geometric neighbors (4 Ag and 4 Hg). Corner-sharing is observed between Ag and Hg tetrahedra and between Ag tetrahedra and Yb 8-vertex polyhedra; Hg tetrahedra also share edges with one another. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites.
